answer_1.quote: We evaluate NeoDiff on a diverse set of NLP tasks, including machine translation, paraphrasing, text simplification, and question generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text sequences (sentences) for each evaluated task

answer_2.quote: We use BLEU score as the evaluation metric across all tasks, supplemented with SacreBLEU for translation tasks.

answer_3.quote: We also included LLM-based evaluation using DeepSeek-V3 685B (DeepSeek-AI, 2024) with specialized prompts, assessing accuracy, fluency, completeness, and task-specific criteria such as creativity for translation and phrasing diversity for paraphrasing.
